name: synthetic_consumption_ev_charging
description: Winter price pattern with high prices during peak hours with Home with overnight EV charging and Winter solar production profile

expected_behavior.description: EV charging load: grid-charge when cheap, export arbitrage during peaks
expected_behavior._note: BATTERY_EXPORT dropped from intents_present in #497. It was satisfied by a single 0.12 kWh export at period 17, which the DP stopped choosing once its phantom load-support export revenue was removed and the whole plan re-optimised -- realized cost on this fixture improved by 0.317 SEK as a result, and corpus-wide genuine exporting went UP (155 -> 210 periods). Per docs/agents/testing.md, intents_present only discriminates on an engineered scenario; on a multi-purpose fixture like this one the pinned expected_results economics are the real guard, and they still cover the same behaviour.
